pages.summary: Blaise toma el timón y coloca su gorra de capitán en Arianna. Daphne pide al elfo que vigile el rumbo; Scorpius despierta y Draco lo acerca para acompañar a la capitana.

panels.scene: At the ketch's helm area, Draco in pale blue-and-white striped linen at left continues bracing a sleeping small human Scorpius in the crook of one arm and on the cushion. Draco's other hand raises his own single pale orange mimosa away from the child like a toast. At right Blaise starts a small gentlemanly bow while securely holding Arianna against his dark navy shirt with one arm. Navy hat still on Blaise, adult eyes dark and uncovered. Arianna has both little ivory bows, tiny dark sunglasses, human blonde curls and her yellow-lemon white dress. Two whole balloons, Draco then Blaise.
dialogue: Draco: Llévenos hasta las sirenas, capitán.
Blaise: Sabía que alguien a bordo reconocería mi autoridad.

panels.scene: Blaise approaches the already established stern helm and places his own right hand on that spoked varnished wooden wheel, reusing the same geometry and brass binnacle. His left forearm stays securely under the small real baby held close against his chest. His single captain hat still on HIS head. The short adult crew lead with cream visor stands near his left shoulder height, taupe linen, pointed ears and adult face, watching the course. Other crew far back can tend sails. No speech.

Medium closeup on one moment of the beloved cap being transferred. Blaise is NOW BAREHEADED, all his actual hair is compact short black round coils, with no long hanging strands. Put his only navy captain hat with tiny gold emblem on Arianna's head, supported while he gently tilts it back with his one free right hand, leaving her whole small human face and own tiny sunglasses visible. Her little naturally separated fingers at brim, white bows can peek out. His left forearm still holds her at the waist and body. Only Blaise's one exact two-sentence balloon.
dialogue: Blaise: Necesito que vigiles el rumbo, capitana. Intenta no distraerte con las sirenas.

panels.scene: Same secure adult support and now oversized captain hat on Arianna only. Baby laughs and taps the wooden wheel with one small hand, the other hand relaxed. Blaise behind and slightly left grins at her in compact round coils, bare head without any sunglasses, holds her steadily. One full exact praise balloon points to father's mouth, never to baby.
dialogue: Blaise: Sabía que podía confiar en ti.

panels.scene: Daphne in cream dress and straw hat speaks softly from left to the same SHORT adult deckhand at right, standing beside the secured mast or varnished bridge. Show his natural small adult pointed-ear anatomy, taupe linen and visor at lower shoulder height. Behind them Blaise, a single distant shadow, watching horizon with Arianna wearing the one navy cap, aboard this same wooden wheel. Two balloons point clearly to Daphne first and crew member second. No additional ears or duplicate baby nearby.
dialogue: Daphne: No dejen de vigilar el rumbo.
Elfo: No apartaremos la vista, señorita Greengrass.

panels.scene: Quiet closeup of the first moment little human Scorpius opens blue-gray eyes. Draco with familiar platinum hair and his adult dark sunglasses, in blue-white striped linen, holds baby close against chest under shoulders and seat with his own supported left arm. His only free hand gently nudges the tiny slightly askew baby glasses up, revealing the baby's eyes. Child has platinum wisps and light gray linen, distinct from Arianna, visible small fingers. All adult cups have been set out of view. No dialogue and no large extra background adults.

Astoria, long dark brown hair under her tied earth-tone scarf, rust linen and blue-gray eyes at left, notices what Scorpius is doing and gives her one line. Draco supports his awake gray-linen baby and gets close to Blaise. Scorpius reaches a single tiny human hand toward the navy hat that Arianna wears; Arianna's own little hand holds its brim. Each child stays with their own adult, limbs clearly attached. Blaise bare dark eyes and compact short coils, gold emblem only on hat on the child's head.
dialogue: Astoria: Creo que Scorpius también quiere dirigir.

panels.scene: Draco approaches the same wood helm a little closer, small Scorpius awake held on one sturdy arm directly under him. Arianna safely held by smiling bareheaded Blaise with her white lemon dress, oversized navy cap and her tiny own dark shades, is near but apart from Scorpius. They look at each other across the same upper part of the wooden wheel. One normal balloon clearly emitted by Draco, full last line. Keep hands and body supports easy to read. No extra faces, hats or glasses.
dialogue: Draco: El capitán necesita un copiloto.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 13 · 55

Blaise toma el timón y coloca su gorra de capitán en Arianna. Daphne pide al elfo que vigile el rumbo; Scorpius despierta y Draco lo acerca para acompañar a la capitana.
Draco: Llévenos hasta las sirenas, capitán.
Blaise: Sabía que alguien a bordo reconocería mi autoridad.
Blaise: Necesito que vigiles el rumbo, capitana. Intenta no distraerte con las sirenas.
Blaise: Sabía que podía confiar en ti.
Daphne: No dejen de vigilar el rumbo.
Elfo: No apartaremos la vista, señorita Greengrass.
Astoria: Creo que Scorpius también quiere dirigir.
Draco: El capitán necesita un copiloto.
pages.review: Se revisaron los ocho paneles y ocho globos de PDF625. Se verificó el timón y la altura del elfo, la gorra única de Blaise a Arianna, la petición de Daphne con su respuesta, el primer despertar de Scorpius y sus gafas levantadas en los dos últimos paneles. Scorpius alcanza la visera con su mano sin tocar las gafas de Arianna, ambos apoyados sobre sus padres.

Hermione: Todavía me cuesta recordar que estamos en invierno.

pages.review: Página completa revisada con PDF626. Los siete globos tienen texto y portadores correctos, incluida la réplica de Blaise. El ketch gira con dos velas y tres portillos, Positano a popa y las tres islas al frente. Robin conserva su cojín junto a las protagonistas. Se rehízo la unión de manos con el anillo en la izquierda de Hermione y la pulsera sola en la de Pansy, con dedos claros. Ambos bebés del timón están despiertos y sostenidos por sus padres.
